DIAMETER::state
Description
This iRules command returns the current state of the Diameter peer’s
connection. There are five possible states:
CLOSED - The connection is down
WAIT_ICEA - still waiting for the initial CEA
ROPEN - The connection has been reopened
IOPEN - The connection is open for the first time
CLOSING - The connection will soon be down
Syntax
DIAMETER
::
state
Examples
Related Information
Valid Events:
DIAMETER_INGRESS
